description: Multi-look de-aliasing super-resolution from TWO offset eyes (Rung 5 of the photon-eye migration). Two low-resolution eyes offset by a KNOWN sub-receptor amount sample ONE flat textured surface; their offset samples interleave at sub-receptor lattice positions, carrying the phase that de-aliases spatial frequencies above either eye's receptor-Nyquist that NEITHER can represent alone (Tsai-Huang microscanning; NOT stereo). The multilook_superres Rust task kind reconstructs the underlying field by band-limited least squares from samples at known nonuniform positions, through one fixed operator; a small ridge damps modes the samples do not constrain, so a genuine sub-receptor OFFSET (interleaved positions -> full-rank high harmonics) recovers detail while a ZERO offset (coincident positions -> rank-deficient) shows NO gain -- the offset is load-bearing through conditioning. This rule mints a SuperResolvedField carrying the reconstruction array. OFF by default: the rule cannot fire unless a SuperresParams node exists (created by the adapter only when the world opts in), and the adapter creates the fusion task only then. Same kernel serves the async two-clock TEMPORAL super-resolution win when positions are TIMES (space-offset == time-offset).

microtheory.name: retinal_superres
microtheory.description: band-limited least-squares fusion of two offset eyes' samples -> de-aliased super-resolved field
